Name: Wilderness of Judah
ModernLocation: Barren hills east of Bethlehem toward the Dead Sea, Israel
Description: The rugged desert east of the Judean hills where David hid from Saul and where John the Baptist would later preach.
BiblicalSignificance: The wilderness of Judah is David's refuge and the psalmist's thirsty land: "my soul thirsteth for thee in a dry land."
